 Deals Black Friday Holiday Deals, Approved by Executive Editor Adrianna Brach
 Shop our executive editor’s cart. Nov. 20, 2026, 3:17 PM EST Adrianna Brach
 Editorial Director
 Share Add TODAY to Google We’ve been busy getting into the holiday spirit at Shop TODAY, and I’m so excited to share that we just launched our annual Gifts We Love Awards alongside our first-ever Shop TODAY magazine , which you can flip through and shop digitally, too! We also just concluded our Shop TODAY Holiday House event here in NYC , and I’ve been loving finds like Target’s adorable St. Jude bear that gives back with every purchase. 
 And if you’re already tackling your holiday shopping list like me, there are some seriously good early Black Friday deals happening now, so there’s no need to wait until Thanksgiving to start saving and checking people off your list!
 Check out some of my favorite deals below!
 Adrianna Brach’s November Picks
 Chunky Gold Bangle Bracelet Set 
 $ 9.48 $ 13.99 Amazon Now 32% off What to know Take the guesswork out of bracelet stacking with this set.
 Styles: 29  | Materials: Alloy, 14K gold plating Statement jewelry is having a moment and this stack gives you that trendy layered look without having to buy a bunch of individual bracelets. This is the easiest way to elevate a simple outfit!
 Lillusory V-Neck Sweater 
 $ 27.99 $ 45.99 Amazon Now 39% off What to know Perfect to pair with jeans, this top lends an easy, polished look to any outfit.
 Colors: 9  | Sizes: S – XL  | Materials: 47% Viscose, 32% Polyester, and 21% Nylon I’m all about pieces that make getting dressed easier, and this collared top gives me a polished look without having to think too hard about my outfit. I love this with jeans or trousers and a pair of sneakers or flats.
 Textured Satin Midi Skirt 
 $ 19.48 $ 89.50 Nordstrom Rack Now 78% off What to know A satin skirt like this one offers versatile styling potential, especially because it's available in a wide variety of colors.
 Colors: 10  | Sizes: XS – XXL  | Materials: 100% polyester A mini satin skirt is one of my favorite wardrobe staples in the fall and winter because you can wear it with just about anything from an oversize sweater to a dressy blouse. This one is under $30 and comes in so many colors!
 BETA Your shortcut to editor approved picks
 SoSoft Mock-Neck Shaker Sweater 
 $ 22.49 $ 44.99 Old Navy Now 50% off What to know A relaxed fit and mock neckline make this an easy, cozy go-to when the weather turns brisk.
 Sizes: XS - 4X  | Colors: 9 You can never have too many cozy sweaters this time of year! I love the relaxed fit and mock neckline on this one, which makes it easy to dress up or down.
 LOFT Petite Sparkle Overlay Midi Dress 
 $ 60.00 $ 120.00 LOFT Now 50% off What to know 'Tis the season for holiday parties and family gatherings! Add some sparkle with this midi dress.
 Sizes: XXS – XXL Holiday party season is around the corner and this sparkly midi dress is such a gorgeous option. I love that it makes a statement without the need for a ton of accessories!
 Dolce Vita Gorgi Bootie Midnight 
 $ 69.98 $ 150.00 DSW Now 53% off What to know Boots are fall and winter must-haves, and this pair can be styled for everyday occasions and festive gatherings alike.
 Sizes: 6 – 11 A good pair of ankle boots can carry you through the entire season, and I love how versatile these are! Wear them with jeans for an everyday look or pair with a holiday skirt for a more festive look.
 Voss+Agin Lab-Grown Diamond Stud Earrings 
 Exclusive deal $ 294.99 $ 849.00 Voss+Agin Now 65% off What to know Choose between 1, 2 and 3 carat total weight.
 CTW: 1, 2, 3 Looking for a gift that feels extra special? These lab-grown diamond earrings are a beautiful option for someone on your list—or as a little treat to yourself!
 Wondershop 6.5' Alberta Spruce LED Pre-Lit Artificial Christmas Tree Bicolor Lights 
 $ 49.00 $ 70.00 Target Now 30% off What to know A pre-lit tree means less time decorating and more time celebrating.
 Light Bulb Count: 250  | Dimensions: 6.5 Feet (H) x 40 Inches (W) x 40 Inches (D) If you haven’t put up your Christmas tree yet, this is your sign. This 6.5-foot spruce from Target comes pre-lit with twinkling lights, so you can spend less time decorating and more time enjoying the holiday magic!
 Marycele Candle Warmer Lamp 
 $ 18.97 $ 39.99 Amazon Now 53% off What to know Forget the matches; this lamp spreads your candle's scent and features timers and a dimmer.
 Styles: 13  | Features: 2/4/8H Timer & 4-Level Dimmer This is one of those gifts that’s both practical and pretty. A candle warmer lets you enjoy your favorite scents without the flame, and it doubles as a cozy little accent lamp.
 Gigglescape Holiday 2026 St. Jude Bear - Ivory 
 $ 15.00 Target What to know Gift wrapping is easier when each bear is adorned with a festive red bow.
 Dimensions: 12.5 in (H) x 11.5 in (W) x 9.5 in (D)  | Material: Polyester How adorable is this little guy? For every $15 bear purchased, Target is donating $3 to St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital through January 2. It’s a sweet gift that gives back, and I love that.
